changelog:
Initial release of Super GitHub – the all-in-one GitHub automation framework.

- Automates issue creation, listing, updating, and labeling.
- Assists with PR review: summaries, file stats, checklists, and conflict detection.
- Streamlines release creation, changelog generation, and tag management.
- Enhances repository management with repo listing, secrets, and workflow tools.
- Merged features from openclaw-github-assistant, github-automation-pro, and github-mcp.
summary: Automate GitHub tasks including issues, PR reviews, releases, and repository management with streamlined creation, updates, summaries, and workflow control.
